title: Populate or delete the dead gamification.dart barrel file
rule: Rule 2 (barrel is the only sanctioned re-export file) / dead code
why: This 7-line file's own doc comment instructs other features to import it as the feature's public surface, but it contains zero `export` statements, and a repo-wide grep confirms zero files import it (the only match for the literal path string is the comment inside the file itself). Meanwhile 5 other features (dashboard, learning, notifications, sync, content_browsing) reach into features/gamification/** via 10+ direct deep imports of domain/models, domain/services, streak/*, and presentation/widgets paths instead. The file is not doing the job it documents itself as doing -- either because the codebase's barrel convention moved to providers.dart (per current coding-standards.md Rule 2) and this file is a stale leftover, or because populating it was simply never finished.
recommendation: Either delete gamification.dart as stale scaffolding, or make it a real public surface (export the symbols the 10 external deep-import sites currently reach for) and redirect those imports through it -- consistent with whichever barrel filename convention (gamification.dart vs providers.dart) the team settles on.
acceptance_criteria: gamification.dart either exports real symbols with at least one external importer, or is removed from the tree

corrections: Recommendation's 'populate gamification.dart' branch conflicts with coding-standards.md Rule 2 ('providers.dart barrel is the only sanctioned re-export file... do not add other barrel/re-export files'); only the delete option is actually standards-compliant, not a coin-flip between two conventions.
